hero_desc: We create focused tools and products that make digital adventures easier to build, manage and share.
intro_text: One guild, several workshops: standalone products and practical tools for players and creators.
programs_lead: Choose a direction and enter the part of the guild built around it.
program_1_desc: Standalone projects created in our workshop: clear, focused and ready for real use.
program_2_desc: Focused utilities that solve everyday tasks and fit naturally into existing workflows.
program_3_desc: CCL is a structured character-creation companion that keeps ideas, choices and important details together in one convenient workspace.

products_intro: Independent tools designed as complete experiences — from the first idea to everyday use.
product_ccl_desc: A dedicated workspace for building characters step by step. CCL helps keep the process readable, structured and easy to revisit.
product_ccl_feature_2: Important character details in one place
product_ccl_feature_3: A focused interface for long creative sessions
principle_1_desc: Each project solves a clear problem without becoming overloaded.
principle_2_desc: The interface explains itself and keeps important actions close.
principle_3_desc: Projects grow through practical improvements and feedback.
tools_intro: Compact utilities made to simplify routine work and keep useful actions close at hand.
tools_catalog_intro: The cabinet is prepared for focused utilities grouped by purpose.
tool_1_desc: Helpers that remove repetitive steps and keep common actions within reach.
tool_2_desc: Focused workspaces for organizing ideas, references and reusable material.
tool_3_desc: Simple instruments for preparing, checking and moving useful information.
